formats.ecsv: ECSV 1.0 (Astropy APE 6): CSV with a YAML header carrying datatype, unit, UCD and description per column
formats.votable: IVOA VOTable 1.5 TABLEDATA with a UCD and a VOUnits unit per FIELD

claimBoundary: Formats and metadata follow the IVOA documents named in each file; the content is the same retained public catalog projection as the JSON release, not an independent measurement. Source membership is not independent confirmation; nothing is averaged across sources.

objects.description: One row per WorldsIndex object (the catalog index): names, position, status, identity state, methods, sources and the population values the atlas selected, each with its source record id and limit flag.

columns.description: Stable identifier of the retained native row (detail shard records[].sourceRecordId).

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: published solution (one publication), source composite (the source's own composite), mission candidate row or catalog row.

columns.name: is_source_default
columns.description: True when the source marks this row as its default parameter set; empty when the source has no such flag.

columns.name: property_code
columns.description: WorldsIndex property code (orbital_period, planet_radius, planet_mass, semi_major_axis, eccentricity, inclination, transit_midpoint, transit_duration, transit_depth, equilibrium_temperature, insolation, planet_star_radius_ratio, semi_major_axis_over_stellar_radius, impact_parameter, stellar_radius).

columns.name: source_field
columns.description: The source's own column the value was read from (its definition pointer).

columns.name: value
columns.description: Value exactly as the source states it, in unit. Units vary by row; never converted here.

columns.name: error_upper
columns.description: Positive uncertainty as the source states it (absolute value), in unit; empty when not stated.

columns.name: error_lower
columns.description: Negative uncertainty as the source states it (absolute value), in unit; empty when not stated.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Unit of value and its errors: a VOUnits string (d, h, K, deg, AU, solRad, 6378100m = Earth radius, 71492000m = Jupiter radius, 5.9721679e+24kg = Earth mass, 1.8981246e+27kg = Jupiter mass), empty for a dimensionless quantity, or percent / ppm for a transit depth the source states on that scale (not VOUnits).

columns.name: limit_type
columns.description: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT or UPPER_LIMIT from the source's own limit flag (NASA *lim: 1 lower, -1 upper); UNKNOWN_LIMIT for a flag outside that convention; empty when the source has no flag.

columns.name: mass_definition
columns.description: For planet_mass: MASS, MINIMUM_MASS_M_SIN_I or MASS_RADIUS_RELATION_ESTIMATE as the source provenance states; empty otherwise.

columns.name: time_system
columns.description: For transit_midpoint: the time system the source states (BJD_TDB; BKJD for Kepler KOI rows, BJD - 2454833.0); empty otherwise.

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Publication reference the source cites for the row (or, for a composite, for this value); empty when the source gives none.

columns.name: reference_url
columns.description: URL of that reference when the source gives one.

columns.name: published
columns.description: Publication date the source states for the row. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

columns.name: updated
columns.description: Row update date the source states. ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

conflicts.description: One row per conflict set with at least two source assertions (object x property, and object status when sources disagree): rows normalised in unit, definition and frame, identity assessed, every pair labelled with the contract relation vocabulary and a verdict at k sigma. Nothing is averaged.

columns.name: object_id
columns.description: Stable WorldsIndex object identifier (the key of the catalog index and the detail shards).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Preferred public designation in this release.

columns.name: host_name
columns.description: Host star or system name as the primary source states it.

columns.name: ra_deg
columns.description: Source-retained right ascension (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: dec_deg
columns.description: Source-retained declination (ICRS) of the object as the atlas projects it.

columns.name: healpix_8_nested
columns.description: HEALPix order 8 (nside 256) nested index of (ra_deg, dec_deg); empty without coordinates. Rows are sorted by it.

columns.name: conflict_set_id
columns.description: Stable conflict-set identifier: conflict-<object_id>-<property_code> (status sets: <property_code> = object_status).

columns.name: property_code
columns.description: Property compared: orbital_period, planet_radius, planet_mass (every mass definition), semimajor_axis, eccentricity, inclination, transit_midpoint, transit_duration, transit_depth, planet_star_radius_ratio, impact_parameter, equilibrium_temperature, insolation, or object_status.

columns.name: canonical_unit
columns.description: Unit every row of the set was normalised to before comparison (VOUnits where one exists: d, 6378100m = Earth radius, 5.9721679e+24kg = Earth mass, AU, deg, h, K; percent for transit depth; empty for a dimensionless quantity or a status). Original values are never changed.

columns.name: row_count
columns.description: Source assertions in the set (one source, one record, one property each).

columns.name: source_count
columns.description: Distinct sources among them.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: Sources in the set, space-separated.

columns.name: definition_codes
columns.description: Definitions present (e.g. mass, minimum-mass, mass-or-minimum-mass), space-separated; rows of different definitions are never compared numerically.

columns.name: relation
columns.description: Most severe pair relation in the contract vocabulary: identity-ambiguity, revision-or-retraction, status-conflict, statistically-inconsistent, definition-incompatible, method-incompatible, epoch-dependent, not-yet-assessed; empty when every assessed pair is consistent.

columns.name: legacy_relation
columns.description: The same set in the ConflictRecord vocabulary of the evidence dossier: AGREEMENT, DISAGREEMENT, INCOMPATIBLE_DEFINITION, STATUS_CONFLICT, IDENTITY_AMBIGUITY or UNASSESSED.

columns.name: in_conflict
columns.description: True when at least one pair is statistically inconsistent, a status conflict, or a revision or retraction; the page then shows every row by default.

columns.name: sigma_threshold
columns.description: k: two comparable point estimates are consistent when they differ by at most k combined (directional) source uncertainties.

columns.name: max_sigma
columns.description: Largest combined-sigma distance among statistically assessed pairs; empty when none was assessed.

columns.name: pairs
columns.description: Pairs of rows in the set (n(n-1)/2).

columns.name: pairs_consistent
columns.description: Pairs with verdict consistent (within k sigma, identical, or a point respecting a limit).

columns.name: pairs_inconsistent
columns.description: Pairs with verdict inconsistent (beyond k sigma, or beyond a limit by more than k sigma).

columns.name: pairs_not_comparable
columns.description: Pairs not compared, with the reason in pairs_by_relation (definition, method, epoch/frame, identity, missing uncertainty, both limits).

columns.name: pairs_by_relation
columns.description: Pair counts per relation, "relation=count" separated by "; " (none = consistent).

columns.name: notable_pairs
columns.description: Up to ten most severe conflicting pairs as "source_record_id/field x source_record_id/field: sigma", separated by " | ".

columns.name: explanation
columns.description: Plain-words statement of the set.

columns.name: policy_version
columns.description: Comparison policy the set was built under.

selections.description: One row per value selected by rule nasa-pscomppars-like.v1 (most recent default parameter set, gaps filled from the latest publication, closed-form values labelled calculated): a selection, not a measurement, beside the source rows, with rule, selector, date, review state, chosen rows and reason.

columns.name: row_kind

columns.name: value

columns.name: unit

columns.description: Positive uncertainty of the chosen row (absolute, in unit); empty for calculated values, which carry none.

columns.name: error_lower
columns.description: Negative uncertainty of the chosen row (absolute, in unit); empty for calculated values.

columns.name: limit_type
columns.description: NONE, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, INTERVAL or UNKNOWN_LIMIT of the chosen row.

columns.name: basis
columns.description: default-solution (the most recent default parameter set), filled-from-publication (the most recently published parameter set that states it) or calculated.

columns.name: chosen_source_id
columns.description: Source of the chosen row; empty for a calculated value (see calculation_inputs).

columns.name: chosen_source_record_ids
columns.description: Source record id(s) chosen (for a calculation, every input row), space-separated.

columns.name: chosen_source_field

columns.name: rule_version
columns.description: Selection rule version (v1).

columns.name: selector

columns.name: selected_at
columns.description: Selection date (the atlas generation time, so an unchanged release selects identically). ISO 8601 text as the source states it; empty when not retained.

columns.name: review_state
columns.description: unreviewed: no human has adopted this selection.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why this row was chosen, in plain words.

columns.name: calculated

columns.name: formula
